Start New Journey With Us!

Join the RIVAL ITS ROBOTICS TEAM and be part of the team making history by developing an Indonesian rover robot that meets world-class competition standards.

Through this internship recruitment program, you will receive training and gain hands-on, practical experience while developing your technical and professional skills, all within a collaborative environment and a strong engineering culture.

GENERAL REQUIREMENTS

  1. 1

    Undergraduate student (S1/D4) at Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember (ITS). Technical divisions are open to the Class of 2026 only, while non-technical divisions are open to the Class of 2025 and 2026.

  2. 2

    Demonstrate a strong willingness to learn and embrace new challenges.

  3. 3

    Able to work collaboratively in a team and perform well under pressure.

  4. 4

    Committed, responsible, and dedicated to contributing to RIVAL ITS.

  5. 5

    Willing to participate in all recruitment stages and internship programs.

Timeline

  1. Open Registration

    19 September 2026

  2. Close Registration

    24 September 2026

  3. Administration Announcement

    28 September 2026

  4. Interview

    30 September – 5 October 2026

  5. Interview Result

    9 October 2026

  6. Internship Start

    12 October 2026

TECHNICAL DIVISIONS

Mechanical

Mission

Design and manufacture durable, efficient, and competition-ready robotic structures.

Focus

Robot mechanical design and manufacturing.

Responsibilities
  • Design robot structures and mechanisms.
  • Manufacture and assemble mechanical components.
  • Operate manufacturing equipment safely.
  • Conduct testing and improve mechanical performance.
Expected Skills
  • CAD Engineering (Fusion 360, Autodesk Inventor, etc.)
  • Manufacturing (bandsaw, drill, conventional/CNC machines, etc.)

Electrical

Mission

Develop reliable electronic and embedded systems that power the robot's performance.

Focus

Hardware and electronic system development.

Responsibilities
  • Assemble electronic components, wiring, and power systems.
  • Develop and integrate embedded systems using microcontrollers.
  • Perform hardware testing and troubleshooting.
  • Integrate sensors and actuators into the robot.
Expected Skills
  • Circuit Design
  • Wiring & Soldering
  • Arduino, ESP32, STM32
  • Electronics Troubleshooting

Programming

Mission

Develop intelligent software that enables the robot to perform autonomously and efficiently.

Focus

Software development and autonomous robot control.

Responsibilities
  • Develop robot control systems.
  • Implement computer vision and sensor processing.
  • Create navigation and automation algorithms.
  • Test, debug, and optimize software performance.
Expected Skills
  • C/C++
  • Python
  • ROS (Robot Operating System)
  • OpenCV
  • Git & Version Control

NON-TECHNICAL DIVISIONS

Creative & Branding

The Creative & Branding division handles the creation and design of all visual content related to the team, including videos, graphics, and social media management. It builds a positive and professional image of the team for public consumption.

Requirements
  • Proficiency in graphic design software.
  • Experience with video production and editing tools.
  • Creative mindset with a good eye for visual aesthetics.
  • Ability to create engaging content to promote the team's image.

Sponsorship & Public Relations

The Sponsorship & Public Relations division manages events and agendas involving the team, maintains relationships with external stakeholders, and ensures effective public communication through social media. This division is also responsible for securing sponsorships and ensuring agreed-upon sponsorship benefits are delivered.

Requirements
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for external relations.
  • Ability to negotiate and secure sponsorship deals.
  • Enthusiasm for networking and maintaining external relations.
  • Understanding of social media platforms for brand communication.

Administration & Finance

The Administration division is responsible for organizing the team's timeline and agenda, managing general team needs, archiving important documents, handling correspondence, and completing the paperwork required for competitions.

Requirements
  • Able to handle and archive documents efficiently.
  • Familiar with managing schedules and team activities.
  • Able to manage official correspondence and maintain confidentiality.
  • Committed and able to work under pressure to meet deadlines.

Required Documents

  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) (ATS or Creative Format).

  • Motivation Letter (minimum 500 words) containing:

    1. 1.Self-introduction
    2. 2.What you know about RIVAL ITS
    3. 3.Your motivation for joining RIVAL ITS
    4. 4.The contributions and innovations you can bring to your chosen division

  • Portfolio (Optional but Recommended, except Creative & Branding)

    Applicants are encouraged to submit a portfolio showcasing projects or experiences relevant to their selected division, such as:

    Technical Dept

    • •Mechanical Division (CAD Design, 3D Modeling, Product Design, Mechanical Projects)
    • •Electrical Division (PCB Design, Circuit Projects, Embedded Systems, Microcontroller Projects)
    • •Programming Division (Software Projects, Programming Projects, Robotics Projects, Algorithm Development)

    Non-Technical Dept

    • •Creative & Branding Division (Graphic Design, Branding, UI/UX Design, Photography, Videography, Content Creation) (Must submit the portfolio)
    • •Administration & Finance Division (Event Documentation, Reports, Financial Reports, Budgeting, Spreadsheet Projects)
    • •External Relation & Sponsorship Division (Sponsorship Proposals, Partnership Decks, Marketing Campaigns, Social Media Campaigns, Business Projects)

Non-Technical Special Task

Administration & Finance

Prepare financial statements and a Cost Estimate (RAB) for RIVAL ITS TEAM to compete in the Thematic Robot Contest at Universitas Muhammadiyah Surakarta.

External Relations & Sponsorship

Create a video that is at least 3 minutes and no more than 8 minutes long, in which you are a member of the RIVAL ITS Team in a single scene of the video. (English/Bahasa allowed)

Just as your rival team has finished the ARCH competition and won first place after being nominated for “Best Rookie Team” in its first year at ARCH, you are approached by a representative from PT Siemens as a potential sponsor for your rival team. You must explain your rival team’s achievements and its potential to attract sponsorship, answer various questions with confidence and professionalism, and convince the sponsor through persuasive communication.

Interview Scenario

  • How do you feel about the ITS Rival Team’s victory?
  • What are the ITS Rival Team’s strengths compared to other teams?

Presentation Scenario

  • Deliver a presentation to a company to convince them of the benefits of sponsoring the ITS Rival Team. Speak directly without using PowerPoint or visual aids.

Creative & Branding

  • Make a video introducing yourselfCreate a creative self-introduction video that’s at least 30 seconds long.
